description: This file defines the 'PaymentAddress' controller class for handling API requests related to payment address management in an OpenCart e-commerce system. It includes methods for validating, setting, and retrieving payment address data, interacting with models such as country, zone, address format, and custom fields.

classes.name: PaymentAddress
classes.description: Controller class for managing payment address via API requests, extending the base system Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles validation and setting of payment address information based on POST data, returning success or error messages.

methods.name: setAddress
methods.description: Sets the current session's payment address to an existing address identified by address ID.
